Subject: New supplier onboarding — Nordic Supplies AS (VAT docs + invoice format)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro — I'm Ola from Nordic Supplies AS (finance). We're ready to get into Redwood's vendor system so you can raise POs for the Q1 hardware deliveries. A couple of items to confirm on our side related to VAT and invoicing so your AP team can process our invoices without delays: 

- We are Norway-registered (Org no. 987654321). Our VAT reg certificate is attached.
- Do you require invoices gross with Norwegian VAT or do you apply reverse-charge (Redwood is EU/UK registered for VAT)? If reverse-charge applies please confirm the VAT ID Redwood wants on invoices.
- Preferred invoice fields: PO number, Redwood billing contact, accounting code (if provided).
- Any special PO routing for dedicated hardware orders (e.g., separate PO for freight)?

I've attached: EU-VAT-Registration.pdf and a sample invoice (Nordic-Supplies-Invoice-Sample.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,

Hi Ola — thanks for the docs and the sample invoice, appreciated. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

1) VAT treatment: Redwood will need to confirm whether the reverse-charge is applicable. For services supplied to a non-Norwegian group we often use reverse-charge; for goods shipped from Norway we may be charged Norwegian VAT at source. Our tax/accounting team (cc'd: Marcus) needs the invoice detail you sent so they can confirm.

2) Redwood VAT/Tax details: we can provide a Redwood VAT ID to appear on the invoice if reverse-charge applies. I'll confirm the exact ID once Marcus verifies.

3) PO workflow: Procurement will create a PO per shipment. Please put our PO number in the invoice 'Reference' field and include your VAT number and company reg number. If freight is billed separately, we prefer freight on a separate PO to help our cost-center mapping.

4) Required documents: copy of company registration + VAT certificate (you provided), and banking details (IBAN + SWIFT). If you can additionally provide a signed vendor onboarding form (I attached our PO template below) it speeds ledger setup.

I've attached Redwood-PO-template.xlsx — fill the billing block and return. Marcus, can you confirm whether Redwood will instruct VAT reverse-charge or pay VAT on import?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-PO-template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks for sending, Ola — quick tax note from our finance group: 

- For goods shipped from Norway into our EU/UK operations, import VAT is typically collected at border and reclaim processes differ by entity. If Redwood receives goods directly into our EU entities and we're VAT-registered in that jurisdiction we can apply reverse-charge on services; for goods, import VAT may be charged.
- To minimise friction, please:
  * Put the Redwood billing address on the invoice exactly as on the PO
  * Include your Norwegian VAT number and company reg number on each invoice
  * Add a line: "Reverse charge applies — VAT to be accounted by the recipient" only if you believe the supply is VAT-exempt/subject to reverse charge. Otherwise show VAT amount charged.

I'll follow up with our tax advisor and confirm the VAT ID you should use. Also, procurement — when you submit your vendor onboarding packet please flag whether the items are goods vs services; that'll determine whether Customs/import VAT rules apply.

Marcus Lin
Finance — AP Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick procurement checklist add-on from my side (to avoid PO/invoice rework):

- Please confirm EORI/Customs ID if shipments leave Norway into EU — helps customs clearance and correct import VAT treatment.
- If freight is pre-paid by vendor, include separate freight line and mark who is paying duties/insurance.
- When issuing the first invoice: include PO number, vendor bank details, vendor VAT number, and attach proof of delivery (POD) or waybill reference.
- For reverse-charge invoices: include Redwood's VAT ID (I'll coordinate with Marcus once he confirms) and the explicit phrase: "VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 194 (reverse charge)" or local equivalent.

Once AP confirms the vendor record I'll send a short procurement acceptance note.

Thanks,
Kristin Berg
Independent Procurement Consultant
[Attachment: procurement-checklist-vendor-onboarding.pdf (pdf)]
